Administrative Procedure Act (APA) – 5 USC §551 et seq.
§553: Rulemaking – Notice-and-comment rulemaking. Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM). Public comment period. Final rule publication in Federal Register.
§554: Adjudications – formal hearings.
§701-706: Judicial review. §706: Scope of review – arbitrary, capricious, abuse of discretion standard. Substantial evidence standard. De novo review.
